svg.title: A call replaced by its contract: what the summary does to the caller's tags, against the real body
svg.text: A call replaced by its contract (stub_verified): summary against real body, at the tracked byte
(a) stub_ub_after: the summary acts like the body

g.text: #[kani::modifies(x)]
fn bump(x: &mut u32) { *x = x.wrapping_add(1); }
let p = &mut x as *mut u32; // tag 1, child of 0
let r = unsafe { &mut *p }; // tag 2, child of 1
bump(unsafe { &mut *p }); // argument: tag 3, child of 1

svg.text: Real body

g.text: entry: retag x with a protector: tag 4, child of 3 (reads through 3)
*x = ...: write through 4. Child for 0, 1, 3, 4; foreign for 2:
2 goes Reserved to Disabled
return: the protector of 4 ends; tag 4 is dropped

svg.text: Summary (the replace function Kani generates)

g.text: entry: same retag with a protector: tag 4, child of 3
requires, in spec mode: no effect on the borrow state
havoc of the modifies target *x: a write through 4, so 2 is Disabled
ensures, in spec mode; return as above

svg.text: Both: *r = 2 writes through a Disabled tag: UB reported.
The summary performs the write the body may perform, through the
same tag, so it invalidates the same caller references.
Tags at x after the call

g.text: 0 Active 1 Active 2 Disabled 3 Active (both, real and summary)

svg.text: Kani, with the stub: FAILED (UB). Miri on the concrete
program: UB. Code: examples/contracts.rs.
(b) peek: the summary misses a read

g.text: static mut G: *mut u32;
#[kani::modifies(y)]
fn peek(y: &mut u32) -> u32 { *y = 0; unsafe { *G } }
let p = &raw mut x; // tag 0 (no retag)
let r = unsafe { &mut *p }; // tag 1, child of 0
*r = 1; G = p; // 1 Active
peek(&mut y); *r = 2; // UB

svg.text: Real body

g.text: *G: a read through tag 0 (G's tag, kept in shadow memory)
foreign for 1: Active becomes Frozen
then *r = 2: a child write on Frozen: UB reported

svg.text: Summary

g.text: only the write to the modifies target y (another object):
nothing happens at x, and 1 stays Active
then *r = 2: allowed: no UB reported

svg.text: False verification today (measured):
check_peek (proof_for_contract): SUCCESSFUL
peek_real: FAILED (UB); peek_stubbed: SUCCESSFUL
Miri: write through a Frozen tag. modifies bounds writes,
not reads, and the summary models no reads.
Tags at x after the call

g.text: real body: 0 Active, 1 Frozen; summary: 0 Active, 1 Active

svg.text: A write through G that modifies names is reported as
inconclusive (poke_stubbed). Code: examples/summary_reads.rs.
